mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.version, a.rule_key, a.reference_key, b.name AS reference_name, c.id AS feature_id, c.feature_key, COALESCE(c.custom_name, c.default_name) AS feature_name, d.id AS app_id, d.name AS app_name, e.id AS domain_id, e.name AS domain_name, a.name, a.pattern, a.scope_type, a.reset_period, a.start_value, a.enabled, a.system_preset, (b.default_rule_key = a.rule_key) AS default_rule, a.description, ((SELECT count(*) FROM t_sys_number_reference usage_ref WHERE usage_ref.default_rule_key = a.rule_key) + (SELECT count(*) FROM t_sys_basic_data_category usage_category WHERE usage_category.number_rule_key = a.rule_key AND usage_category.number_mode != 'MANUAL')) AS usage_count FROM t_sys_number_rule a INNER JOIN t_sys_number_reference b ON b.reference_key = a.reference_key INNER JOIN t_sys_feature c ON c.id = b.feature_id INNER JOIN t_sys_app d ON d.id = c.app_id INNER JOIN t_sys_domain e ON e.id = d.domain_id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.reference_key, a.name, b.id AS feature_id, b.feature_key, COALESCE(b.custom_name, b.default_name) AS feature_name, c.id AS app_id, c.name AS app_name, d.id AS domain_id, d.name AS domain_name FROM t_sys_number_reference a INNER JOIN t_sys_feature b ON b.id = a.feature_id INNER JOIN t_sys_app c ON c.id = b.app_id INNER JOIN t_sys_domain d ON d.id = c.domain_id ORDER BY d.seq, c.seq, COALESCE(b.custom_seq, b.default_seq), a.reference_key

INSERT INTO t_sys_number_counter (rule_key, scope_key, period_key, current_value) VALUES (#{ruleKey}, #{scopeKey}, #{periodKey}, #{startValue}) ON CONFLICT (rule_key, scope_key, period_key) DO UPDATE SET current_value = t_sys_number_counter.current_value + 1, update_time = now() RETURNING current_value
SELECT count(*) FROM t_sys_basic_data_category a WHERE a.number_rule_key = #{ruleKey} AND a.number_mode != 'MANUAL'
SELECT count(*) FROM t_sys_number_reference a WHERE a.default_rule_key = #{ruleKey}
SELECT count(*) FROM t_sys_number_counter a WHERE a.rule_key = #{ruleKey}
